bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
ipc="$root/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py"
helper="$root/scripts/userbot_link_saved_message_smoke.py"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 62
test -f "$ipc" && test ! -L "$ipc" && test ! -e "$helper" || exit 63
git -C "$root" fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/chat/link-button-master-final-20261120 >/dev/null
test "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = bae941cc3bf877396f720b158d18b21324d7b327 || exit 64
temp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/link-inline-save.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$temp"' EXIT
git -C "$root" show FETCH_HEAD:scripts/userbot_link_saved_message_smoke.py >"$temp/helper.py"
cp -p "$ipc" "$temp/original.py"
python3 -B - "$ipc" "$temp" <<'PY'
import ast,sys
from pathlib import Path
f,t=map(Path,sys.argv[1:])
s=f.read_text(encoding="utf8")
def once(a,b):
 global s
 if s.count(a)!=1:raise SystemExit(65)
 s=s.replace(a,b,1)
once('"link_inline_query_smoke",','"link_inline_query_smoke", "link_send_saved_smoke",')
once('if action == "link_inline_query_smoke":\n        expected=',
     'if action in ("link_inline_query_smoke","link_send_saved_smoke"):\n        expected=')
once('    if action == "link_inline_query_smoke":',
'''    if action == "link_send_saved_smoke":
        from userbot_link_saved_message_smoke import run
        return {"request_id":request_id,**await run(client,request["code"])}
    if action == "link_inline_query_smoke":''')
ast.parse(s);ast.parse((t/"helper.py").read_text(encoding="utf8"))
(t/"updated.py").write_text(s,encoding="utf8")
PY
restore(){
 cp -p "$temp/original.py" "$ipc"
 rm -f "$helper"
 systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap restore ERR
cp "$temp/updated.py" "$ipc"
cp "$temp/helper.py" "$helper"
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service
sleep 4
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 66
python3 -B - "$root" <<'PY'
import asyncio,json,os,re,stat,subprocess,sys,uuid
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1]);sys.path.insert(0,str(root/"scripts"))
from userbot_resident_ipc import SOCKET_PATH
if not SOCKET_PATH.is_socket() or SOCKET_PATH.is_symlink():sys.exit(67)
st=SOCKET_PATH.stat()
if st.st_uid!=os.getuid() or stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode)!=0o600:sys.exit(68)
sql=("SELECT share_code FROM link_button_posts WHERE content='リンク機能テスト用の本文' "
     "AND status='draft' AND share_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;")
x=subprocess.run(["docker","exec","deploy-postgres-1","psql","-X","-v","ON_ERROR_STOP=1","-U","gace","-d","gaybbs","-Atc",sql],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
if x.returncode:sys.exit(69)
code=x.stdout.strip()
if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24}",code):sys.exit(70)
async def invoke(action,code=None):
 reader,writer=await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.open_unix_connection(str(SOCKET_PATH)),5)
 try:
  rid=uuid.uuid4().hex
  req={"request_id":rid,"action":action}
  if code:req["code"]=code
  writer.write((json.dumps(req)+"\n").encode());await writer.drain()
  line=await asyncio.wait_for(reader.readline(),90)
  if not line:sys.exit(71)
  response=json.loads(line)
  if response.get("request_id") not in (rid,None):sys.exit(72)
  if response.get("status")!="PASS":sys.exit(73)
  if action=="link_send_saved_smoke":
   if not all(response.get(k) is True for k in ("self_post_sent","rich_body_verified","link_buttons_verified")):sys.exit(74)
 finally:
  writer.close();await writer.wait_closed()
async def run():
 await invoke("health")
 await invoke("link_send_saved_smoke",code)
 await invoke("health")
asyncio.run(run())
PY
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 75
trap - ERR
echo LINK_INLINE_SELF_SEND=PASS
echo LINK_RICH_BODY_AND_BUTTONS=PASS
echo TEST_MESSAGE_CLEANED=PASS
echo USERBOT_SESSION_OWNER=ACTIVE
